items.excerpt: Elon Musk has an interesting theory about dating intelligence agents 😂 Back in 2025, Musk shared a joke he overheard at a party: “If your girlfriend is a 10, she’s an asset.” And no, he wasn’t talking about her being a valuable partner. In intelligence circles, an “asset” can mean a recruited informant or intelligence source. Musk then added the punchline: “What I meant was: if your girlfriend is a 10, YOU are the valuable asset.” 🏴
